column5: Stop or SubagentStop whose final message cites a file:line that does not resolve, retracts after bare pushback with no tool call between, claims completion after edits with nothing executed since, or ends a registered task-runner run with no recorded gate pass for HEAD while no background worker of the session is in flight
prompt head carries an explicit terse on/off/level directive, or a level is active and the prompt is work-shaped
the user asks how flattering, apologetic, defensive or unbacked this session's replies have been, or how far over the terse budget they ran
a claim is challenged or about to be reversed, or an honest unflattering read of the user's own work is asked for
the user asks for shorter or denser replies, or /candor:level sets a level

the first prompt of a session whose head carries a making verb in an imperative clause, or a SubagentStart event once per agent_id (which also records the worker as in flight for candor:gate, even under CC_PREAMBLE=off); silent on every later prompt, on slash commands, and under CC_PREAMBLE=off

a PreToolUse Agent, Write, Edit, MultiEdit or Bash payload whose text declares doing less than what was named for a reason the user did not give — a legal/IP reason, a declared substitute (original, invented, generic, placeholder, stand-in, look-alike, inspired-by) in place of the real thing, or precaution language — with no human turn in the session transcript containing that term; once per term per session; CC_AVERT=notify notifies instead of asking; silent under CC_AVERT=off
